statement: For every term V(y, z) not containing x, every anchored model of (x*y)*z = x*V(y, z) is a translation table x*y = x + 1 + k(y) with k a permutation of Z/N fixing 0, and k satisfies k(V(y,z)) = k(y) + k(z) + 1.
title: Right-normed laws (xy)z = x V(y,z) have only translation models
